[1/6] Planning: proper story mechanics (requirement-gated choices, persistent story flags, follow-up transmissions, branch-skipped chapters, ending resolution, 5-act campaign with old-save migration) plus void traversal (deterministic void lanes between black-hole systems, void dive/emerge, tick-driven storms and arrival)

impact_assessment.why: The narrative campaign is a static 3-act linear chain whose choices have no persistent consequences, and the game named VoidFarer has no mechanics for traversing the void between stars despite black-hole systems existing
impact_assessment.benefits: Branching consequences that persist and gate later content, branch-resolvable locked choices with reasons, distinct campaign endings, and a deterministic risk-reward void travel layer with CLI/REST/cockpit parity
impact_assessment.risks: contract: story save schema grows (flags, requirements, endings) and the campaign extends from 3 to 5 acts so the old completed-campaign test contract changes; dependency: none added (stdlib only); concurrency: existing engine lock retained for all new mutations; state: ShipState gains void_traversal with None default and StoryState gains flags/ending_id with empty defaults, both backward compatible via from_dict migration
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for every new behavior, additive serialization defaults for old saves, migration reopens a completed 3-act save into the 5-act campaign deterministically, the changed test contract is recorded in the ADR per PRINCIPLE-014 R2, and all lanes/storms derive from the galaxy seed and engine RNG

[1/6] Planning: living crew morale (event-driven morale shifts, paid shore leave at stations, resignation risk below morale 20, inactive-crew drift bugfix), volume-aware market execution (sliced orders walk prices with the shifting stockpile, average-price and impact reporting), and cash-flow telemetry (upkeep vs passive income per tick in snapshot, CLI status, and crew tab)

impact_assessment.why: Crew morale only moves +/-0.1-0.8 per tick via wages with no events, consequences, or player agency; bulk trade orders execute at a flat pre-trade quote so dumping large volumes has zero price impact; and the negative baseline wage burn (-65 cr/tick vs ~+19 passive) is invisible to the player, weakening the simulation feel and the retention loop around crew management
impact_assessment.benefits: Crew becomes a living system with stakes (resignations) and a credit-sink lever (shore leave); markets punish bulk dumps and reward order sizing; players can see and manage their net cash flow; combat, void storms, hostile arrivals and story resolutions now feed back into crew state
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tick_crew gains an rng parameter and removes resigning crew, trade messages gain impact wording, and the market response for bulk orders changes; dependency: none added; concurrency: engine lock retained, shore leave mutates under it; state: no schema change (morale and stockpiles already serialized), resignation only removes existing crew entries
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for every behavior, single-unit orders keep the legacy price and message shape so the tutorial and existing trade tests stay valid, resignation is seeded from the engine rng for determinism (G-012), shore leave validates docking and credits atomically, and CLI/REST/cockpit parity is covered by tests plus layout regressions

[1/4] Planning: simulation-depth pass on combat and void traversal - progression-scaled encounter threat with early-boss gating, consistent evasive-burn disengagement (fuel cost, streak/combo reset), and Hollow resonance risk-reward with partial emergency payout plus CLI/REST/cockpit telemetry

impact_assessment.why: Combat difficulty never scales with player progression, a 30% anarchy dreadnought roll can ambush a level-1 hull, free evasive burns dodge the loss-aversion streak reset, and void traversal only punishes storms with no variable reward or bail-out value
impact_assessment.benefits: Keeps the combat flow channel as mastery grows, removes an early-game unfair spike, closes the streak-preserving escape exploit, and turns passive void waiting into a risk/reward loop with transparent resonance payouts
impact_assessment.risks: contract: generated enemy stats/bounties and VoidTraversalState serialization change, evasive burn gains a fuel cost; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: engine RLock retained, all new mutation stays inside it; state: resonance is an additive default-0.0 field and old saves load unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for scaling, boss gating, evasive-burn costs, resonance accrual/payouts and serialization; generate_system_enemy keeps threat_level=1 defaults so existing callers/tests are unchanged; partial emergency payout is capped below full arrival value; CLI/REST/cockpit parity and G-012 determinism verified
